purpose: Teach: 逆襲/脱落/総統/総督/ゆだね/波乱/バイパス/リバウンド

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、業界に逆襲を仕掛けられた
lines.en: Your father, when he was founding the company — he fought back against the whole industry.
lines.style: Measured, respectful cadence. Slow breath between thoughts. Voice carries weight of memory, not nostalgia. Eyes distant but present. A grandfather speaking truth, not seeking agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の脱落を防がれた
lines.en: That's right. He kept his people from falling away when it would have been easy.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Steady tone — no flourish. Speaking as though confirming something sacred. Slight emphasis on 'kept,' like a responsibility understood and honored.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、独裁的な総統経営はされなかった
lines.en: He never became a tyrant, even when he could have.
lines.style: Gentle observation, edged with something deeper — maybe regret, maybe wisdom earned late. Slow pace. Voice slightly softer, as if naming something precious that almost didn't survive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは旧総督府関係の縁を大事にされた
lines.en: No. He valued the relationships that mattered — the ones that came before, the ones that would come after.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Speaking from a place of having watched and understood. Not explaining, but confirming. Small pause before 'mattered,' like touching something fragile.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若手に責任をゆだねる勇気をお持ちだった
lines.en: He had the courage to give real responsibility to the young people coming up.
lines.style: Voice carries pride without showing it. Steady, almost ceremonial pacing. Slight lift on 'courage' — naming something rare. Trailing off slightly, like he's seeing it happen again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは波乱の時代を乗り切られた
lines.en: Yes. And he weathered the storms that came — the hard times that would have broken someone smaller.
lines.style: Deep, measured tone. Each phrase deliberate. Speaks of hardship without drama. Solid as bedrock. A son speaking the inheritance his father left him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、物流のバイパス網を整備された
lines.en: He built the networks that would keep the company moving, even when the usual paths were closed.
lines.style: Reflective, almost architectural in tone — building something, not just listing it. Steady pace. Voice carries respect for practical vision. Slight warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不況のリバウンドを的確に捉えられた
lines.en: He did. And he read the moment — when things turned, he was already ahead of it, preparing.
lines.style: Quiet closing. Deeply present. Voice settles like an ending is coming. Not final, but resting. A father honoring his father's foresight. The last word carries the weight of what was built because someone saw ahead.
